sentences.text: Wellbore 15/9-F-11 T2 on Volve has reports from 2013-03-23 to 2013-05-14, in 53 reports.
The report span is 52.96 days with 53 active days, in 1 campaign.
The deepest measured depth reported is 4562.1 m with a true vertical depth of 3398.2 m.
Sodir lists a total depth of 4562.0 m for the parent wellbore, because Sodir does not list technical sidetracks.
Total activity time is 1230.5 h, of which primary lost time is 177.75 h, or 14.45 % of the activity time.

The main outcome is that the well was drilled to its final depth, logged, and then plugged back with cement. The last report records a kick-off to F-11 A from the plug, so this wellbore ended as a plugged-back sidetrack parent (Sodir status P&A, purpose observation).
Campaign 1 runs from 2013-03-23 to 2013-05-14, a span of 52.96 days with 53 active days, and its dominant operation phase is drilling.
No later campaign (completion, workover or abandonment) is recorded for this wellbore.

Section 1 is 26.0 in hole, from 2013-03-23 to 2013-04-12, drilled from 257.0 m to 1365.0 m with a true vertical depth of 1340.5 m at section end; new hole is 1108.0 m at an average rate of 16.0 m/h while coded drilling -- drill (not an on-bottom rate of penetration).

Section 2 is 17.5 in hole, from 2013-04-13 to 2013-04-27, drilled from 1368.0 m to 2577.0 m with a true vertical depth of 2444.0 m at section end; new hole is 1212.0 m at an average rate of 14.87 m/h while coded drilling -- drill (not an on-bottom rate of penetration).

Section 3 is 8.5 in hole, from 2013-04-28 to 2013-05-08, drilled from 2577.0 m to 4562.1 m with a true vertical depth of 3398.2 m at section end; new hole is 1985.1 m at an average rate of 14.0 m/h while coded drilling -- drill (not an on-bottom rate of penetration).

Section 4 has an unknown hole size (the hole size source is unknown, so none is stated); it runs from 2013-05-09 to 2013-05-14 between 4562.0 m and 4562.1 m with a true vertical depth of 3398.2 m at section end, and drilled 0.0 m of new hole, so no drilling rate applies (no new hole).
Section 1 starts below a casing shoe at 202.3 m and set casing with its shoe at 1357.7 m.
The report text that records running this casing names it as a string of the following size:
Section 2 starts below the shoe at 1357.7 m and set casing with its shoe at 2570.7 m.
A later report names that shoe in the words:
Section 3 starts below the shoe at 2570.7 m and no casing was set in it (casing shoe not reported).
Section 4 also starts below the shoe at 2570.7 m and no casing was set in it.
Primary lost time is 177.75 h over 55 activities, 14.45 % of the 1230.5 h of wellbore activity time.
By section, primary lost time is 72.5 h in section 1 (15.28 % of its activity time) and 86.5 h in section 2 (24.03 %).
Section 3 has 0.0 h of primary lost time, and section 4 has 18.75 h (14.2 % of its activity time).
By cause, primary lost time is 74.0 h waiting on weather, 71.0 h repair and 32.75 h waiting (other waits, mainly riser and cement).

Possible lost time is reported separately and is not added to the primary figures: 119.5 h in total, 9.71 % of the activity time, of which 104.75 h is in section 1, 7.0 h in section 2 and 7.75 h in section 3.

On 2013-03-24 the crew found that the bearing of the crown block fast-line sheave had seized onto its shaft, an activity of 4.0 h; the 26.0 in assembly was pulled and the sheave was changed out over the following days (coded as possible lost time, mostly maintain).
On 2013-04-04 a 20 inch casing joint with damaged box threads was pulled, replaced and the string run back, taking 6.0 h of primary lost time.
On 2013-04-07 a riser connection test failed because an o-ring was missing, costing 6.0 h of primary lost time (coded wait); another riser connection needed its o-ring replaced later the same day.

Waiting on weather, because cuttings could not be back-loaded to the supply vessel in heavy wind and sea, started on 2013-04-14 (8.0 h in the first activity) and continued until 2013-04-19 (15.5 h in the last activity); the wellbore total for this cause is 74.0 h over 15 activities.
On 2013-04-27 the sound-tracking MWD tool had to be troubleshot after tripping to surface, 5.0 h of primary lost time in section 2.

On 2013-05-08, after wireline logging at final depth, the 8.5 in assembly met a restriction while pulling out, with overpull, stalled rotation and tight spots; working through it took 5.25 h and was not coded as lost time.
The first cement plug was pumped on 2013-05-10, and on 2013-05-11 a wait on cement (with a BOP test) took 12.25 h of primary lost time in section 4.
Hard cement was tagged and a further plug was pumped on 2013-05-12, which is the Sodir completion date of 2013-05-12 (end of drilling of the Sodir wellbore, not production start-up).

The last report date differs from the Sodir completion date because, on 2013-05-14, hard cement was tagged, the plug was drilled and the well was kicked off to F-11 A, where operations were transferred.

Weather windows for cuttings back-loading drove the largest single cause of primary lost time (74.0 h waiting on weather); the next well should plan more cuttings storage or a weather-tolerant disposal route before drilling the 17.5 in section.

Repair time on rig equipment (crown block sheave, pipe handling and top drive equipment, riser connections) totalled 71.0 h of primary lost time; the next well should inspect and grease-service the crown block sheave and pre-test riser flanges and o-rings before spud.
Inspect casing joint threads before running to avoid a repeat of the damaged box, which cost 6.0 h on 2013-04-04.

The restriction met while pulling the 8.5 in assembly on 2013-05-08 argues for planning a wiper or reaming trip before logging and abandonment in the long open hole, and for a weather and wait-on-cement plan that avoids idle rig time (the 12.25 h wait on 2013-05-11 was used for a BOP test, which is a good way to use such time).

Possible lost time (mostly maintain and other interruptions in section 1) should be reviewed separately, because the daily reports code survey work and rig maintenance under it, so it may overstate true lost time.

row.comments:
Checked crown block fast-line sheave and found bearing ceased onto shaft. Evaluated situation and informed offshore and onshore managment. Prepared forward plan to POOH 26" BHA prior to working on fast-line sheave. Barriered off rig floor and cantelever.

Meanwhile:
Circulated well 1100 l/min, 8 bar, 20 RPM, 2 kNm. Attempted to apply lubricant to fast-line sheave.

Broke out wellhead from string and laid down same to deck.
Pulled out of hole with 20" casing string from 1208 m to 1195 m and broke out joint with damaged box threads, laid down same to deck.
Picked up and made up new 20" casing joint and ran in hole to 1208 meter.
Changed to 5 1/2" handling equipment.
Prepared backup wellhead on HTS, made up same to running tool.
Picked up and made up backup wellhead assembly.
Installed  plug set in backup wellhead assembly.

Broke out connection between riser joints #6 and #3 and inspected same.
Found o-ring missing.
Installed o-ring in outer groove.
Made up connection between riser joints #6 and #3 and re-tested same to 35 bar, test ok.

Waited on weather.
Not able to back load cuttings from ISO tanks to supply vessel due to heavy wind and sea.

Meanwhile:
Circulated hole clean at 1500 meter with 4300 liter/min, 248 bar.
Pulled back into shoe.
Circulated with 1440 liter/min, 35 bar.
Picked up and racked back 5 1/2" DP.

Waited on weather to back load cuttings.

Meanwhile:
Circulated with 1420 lpm,  33 bar, 0 rpm.
Troubleshoot SoundTrack tool. POOH to 7 m and plugged into OnTrack tool, verified software communication.

Pulled out of hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly from 4562m MD to 4467m MD. Took 5MT overpull at 4467m MD. Attempted to pass restriction several times with maximum 30MT - no go. Attempted to run in hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly with up to 40 MT - no go. Established circulation with 1300 lpm and 54 bar, no losses. Attempted to establish rotation - no go. 

Applied full string weight, and established rotation. Reamed stand down from 4467m MD to 4482m MD. Attempted to ream stand up several times - no go. Stalled out at 4467m MD.
Stopped rotation and circulation and attempted to pull 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly out of hole from 4467m MD - no go. Established rotation with 50 rpm. Got passed restriction.

Pulled / reamed out of hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly from 4467m MD to 4407m MD with 1400 lpm, 31 bar, 50 rpm and 16-30 kNm. Observed tight spots at 4468m and 4460m.

Pumped 11.8 m3 of 1.50 sg spacer. Mixed and pumped 10 m3 of 1.90 sg cement slurry. Displaced the cement to the rig floor with 890 l of drill water. Reset stroke counters. Pumped 2.8 m3 of 1.50 sg spacer. Displaced the cement with 40.6 m3 (1833 strokes) of 1.32 sg OBM. Underdisplaced with 2.5m3.

Rotated with 20 rpm and 15 kNm during displacement.
Ran in hole with cement stinger from 5 1/2" drill pipe from 2505m MD to 14" casing shoe at 2570,7m MD. Broke circulation with 2500 lpm and recorded pressures (179 bar). Took up and down weights.

Waited on cement.

Meanwhlie: Performed prejob meeting prior to pick up and make up BOP test tool. Removed PS21 slips and installed master bushings. Picked up and made up BOP test tool, removed protective tape and inspected seals. Ran in hole with BOP test tool on 5 1/2" drill pipe to wellhead at 138m MD. Displaced riser and surface lines to sea water.

Pressure tested BOP to 345 bar.  Pressure tested standpipe manifold to 345 bar.

Displaced BOP to surface to 1.32 sg OBM. Pulled out of hole with BOP test tool on 5 1/2" drill pipe from 138 m MD. Broke out and laid down same.

Troubleshooting on top drive encoder. Function tested same. Function tested 3 1/2" auto slips. Performed general maintanence and housekeeping.

Pressure tested cement line to 200 bar and verified line up. 

Pumped 20 m3 of 1.50 sg spacer. Mixed and pumped 13.5 m3 of 2.00 SG cement slurry. Displaced the cement to the rig floor with 790 l of drill water. Pumped 3.3 m3 of 1.50 SG spacer. Displaced the cement with 24 m3 (1083 strokes) of 1.28 sg OBM.
Washed in hole with 3 1/2" cement stinger on 5 1/2" drill pipe from 4044m MD to 4104m MD with 200 lpm and 20 bar. Tagged hard cement at 4104 with 10MT.

Kicked off to F-11 A by drilling from 2578m MD to 2586m MDwith 1800 lpm, 120 bar and 60 rpm. 50% cement / formation in returns verified at 2586m MD.

****Transferred operations to F-11 A****
